en: A multiview color postcard showing several landmarks of the city of Pécs. The central circular image features a tall telecommunications tower rising above green trees. Surrounding it are four rectangular views: an old chapel on a grassy hill, a domed former mosque in a busy square with many cars, a modern multi‑storey building complex set among trees, and a large Romanesque cathedral with two tall towers flanking its façade. The front has a turquoise sky background with a yellow band containing Hungarian text. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with space for address and stamp, and small printed text in Hungarian and Cyrillic.
